note: BH-9586. A ticket sat in phase ejected past its limit, but its PR is closed and merged: the work landed, so a rebuild or a requeue would act on merged work. settle_merged re-reads the PR, checks with GitHub's compare that the merge sha is on the PR's base branch, moves the ticket to merged (actor lifecycle), then removes a leftover MC_MERGIFY_LABEL (default merge-queue) label. A null field (an unread pull, no merge sha, no base ref) never matches and falls to the U12 card. Disjoint from U14-REQUEUE, which takes an open, unmerged PR. One decision per stuck episode.
